name: Todoist
tagline: Cross-platform task manager for projects, reminders, and recurring tasks

pricing.notes: Official pricing/help checked 2026-07-30; Pro monthly changed to $7/month and $5/month annually from Dec 10, 2025.

verdictSummary: A personal task app with projects, recurring due dates, filters, and reminders is a one-sitting/weekend build; collaboration and sync polish are the product moat.
coreLoopDIY: Create task/project tables, natural-language due date parsing, recurring rules, reminders, filters, and local notifications.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because task capture must be fast everywhere and reminders cannot miss.

priorArt.name: Vikunja
priorArt.desc: Open-source task/project management app suitable as a Todoist-style alternative.

notes: Strong yes; familiar product where feature creep is the real limit.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Todoist (Cross-platform task manager for projects, reminders, and recurring tasks). Requirements:

- Core loop: Create task/project tables, natural-language due date parsing, recurring rules, reminders, filters, and local notifications.
- Needs: local or hosted database.
- Needs: date parser.
- Needs: notification channel.
- Needs: optional mobile/desktop wrappers.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: native apps; offline sync; collaboration.
